meta.name: Prompt Element Taxonomy
meta.source_note: Single source of truth for the Prompt Template Creator (HTML), the taxonomy reference (PDF), and the configurator (XLSX). Edit here; regenerate with src/build_builder.py, src/build_taxonomy_pdf.py, src/build_configurator_xlsx.py. v1.1 adds a research-backed "why" (effect on output + evidence) to every attribute.

oop_legend.element: class — a major building block of a prompt (Role, Task, … Mission, Checks)
oop_legend.attribute: property — a configurable slot inside an element (Role.identity, Checks.hard)
oop_legend.option: allowed value — a vetted choice for an attribute, with guidance on when to pick it
oop_legend.technique: method — an operation you can run on/with an element (few_shot(), critique_loop())
oop_legend.template: instance — a saved configuration of elements and choices (the G/A library)
oop_legend.inheritance: agentic elements extend their generative ancestors (Mission extends Task, adding a definition of done)

modes.name: Generative
modes.tagline: A prompt that writes: you ask, it produces text, you read it and act. Five elements + two safety valves.

modes.name: Agentic
modes.tagline: A prompt that works: you brief a job; it plans, uses tools, checks itself, and reports with evidence. Twelve blocks — the mission brief.
